audit_items.proof_trace: Both non-liquidation price functions (collaterals_usd_non_liquidation and debts_value_usd_non_liquidation) exclusively call get_price_with_check, which asserts |EMA−spot|/spot ≤ per-asset tolerance and returns the EMA price (not spot). Since the returned price is always EMA, spot manipulation cannot inflate borrowing power even within the tolerance window; the check merely gates whether the oracle state is sufficiently stable to trust.
